# thunder_cgnv6_global_domain_list (Resource)

`thunder_cgnv6_global_domain_list`: Configure the global parameters for the domain-list

__PLACEHOLDER__



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `aaaa_query` (String) 'enable': Enable the DNS AAAA query for each domain in the domain list.; 'disable': Disable the DNS AAAA query for each domain in the domain list.;
- `fail_interval` (Number) Set up the global failure interval in second for the DNS resolution.
- `interval` (Number) Set up the global query interval in minute for the DNS resolution.
- `uuid` (String) uuid of the object

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
